text:
Ivy: Heads-up — new dev ran into weird startup logs in the onboarding sample: INFO lines without request-id, later DEBUG lines include request-id. Seems like init-order/OTEL hook timing.
Connor: Which sample (node/python/go)?
Ivy: Node and Go. Node flow: require sdk -> configure routes -> start OTEL exporter async -> listen. Go flow: init logger in main, then start background otlp goroutine. Env LOG_LEVEL=info.
Yara: Classic race: if logger auto-configs while exporter/hook registration is still in progress, early logs can miss the request id injection. Go often surfaces this because goroutines start quickly.
Ivy: Repro: start sample, curl /live a couple times. First boot logs lack id, subsequent calls show request-id.
Connor: Quick fixes to ship in samples: 1) synchronous bootstrap call at top of main to lock log level (SDK.initLogger / init_logger / InitLogger depending on language); 2) a tiny request-id fallback that assigns an id synchronously for the first request lifecycle; 3) bump sample dependency to the SDK release that contains the OTEL-exporter guard.
Yara: Example Go snippet to run at top of main before spawning exporter goroutine:
Yara: ```go
// main.go - very top
import "github.com/redwood/re_sdk"
func main() {
  re_sdk.InitLogger(map[string]string{"level": os.Getenv("LOG_LEVEL")})
  // now start rest of app
}
```
Ivy: For Node we can require an early file that calls initLogger and attaches an express middleware that sets req.id = header or short uid.
Connor: Also found a header-scrubbing gap: sample's redact regex omitted plus signs and multi-segment TLDs, so headers like x-user: alice+dev@example.co.uk slipped through in DEBUG. New pattern suggestion: `(?:[A-Za-z0-9._%+\-]+)@(?:[A-Za-z0-9\.\-]+)\.[A-Za-z]{2,}` or use SDK.rewriteHeadersRedaction helper.
Ivy: Any parity notes? We should make the same change across node/go/python samples so docs match.
Yara: Absolutely. Also add a tiny smoke CI that starts the sample with LOG_LEVEL=info, hits /health, captures stdout for 2s, and asserts: no DEBUG lines occur before the first line containing `request-id=`. Keep it deterministic: run locally in CI container with 127.0.0.1 binds.
Connor: I'll draft the PR: add early-init snippets for three languages, replace regex with SDK redactor usage, add one-line integ smoke test, and bump deps to SDK >=1.3.4 which has exporter-level guard.
onboard-bot: Created issue devex/samples#5301: "onboard: init guard + request-id fallback + header redaction parity + smoke test (node/go/python)"
Ivy: Nice. I'll open the PR and ping @Connor and @Yara for reviews.
Connor: TY — will review and add the CI job.
Yara: I'll update the quickstart doc blurb: "Bootstrap logger before instrumenting exporters; include request-id fallback; use SDK >=1.3.4 for consistent log levels."
